official_processor_settings.reference: public processor + full model forward, logits_to_keep=1
official_processor_settings.matched: same processor pixel_values, per-patch grid, timestamps, question and template; no eviction

limitations: Video-MME: selected first archive shard, 30/900 videos and 90/2700 QA, no subtitles; evaluation only.
Official-processor control uses A-D likelihoods and also logs unconstrained greedy first tokens; not the model-card generation metric.
ActivityNet: local gold yes/no diagnostic, 40 train QA / 16 videos and 13 held-out QA / 6 disjoint videos; not official ActivityNet-QA.
Long synthetic clips and random-frame alert smoke measure capacity/functionality, not surveillance alert accuracy.
600-step strategy profiles are from a761f09 with untrained new modules; use synchronized medians, not unsynchronized phase timings.
12 training steps and one changed held-out answer cannot establish a reliable quality gain.
Missing optimized GDN kernels limit interpretation of latency; no A100 performance inferred from 5090 results.
